items.title: 2.5 Motion under gravity (gravity ke asar se motion) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.5 with the second Example 2.4 (PDF 33-34, printed 30-31).

blocks.text: Gravity ke asar se freely (khud ba khud) girti hui body uniform acceleration wali rectilinear motion (seedhi line mein motion) ki sab se familiar (jani pehchani) example hai. Galileo ke mutabiq vacuum (khala, jahan hawa na ho) mein sab cheezen acceleration due to gravity se freely girti hain; ise g likhte hain. Is ki experimental value (tajurbe se nikli value) SI units mein 9.8 m s⁻² hai. Matlab yeh ke alag alag cheezen ek hi height se girayi jayen to zameen par ek hi velocity se takrati hain. g ke sign ka rule: girti body ke liye (jab initial velocity zero ho) g positive lete hain, aur vertically (seedha) oopar phenki gayi body ke liye (jab initial velocity zero na ho) negative.
Freely falling body ke liye equations of motion mein a = g rakhne se:

blocks.title: Example 2.4
blocks.problem: 1 kg mass ki lohe ki ball ek tower (minar) se girayi jati hai aur 3.34 s mein zameen par pohanchti hai. Nikalein: (a) tower ki height, (b) zameen se takrate waqt ball ki velocity.
steps: Ball gravity ke asar se gir rahi hai, is liye equations mein a = g rakhenge.
Given: m = 1 kg, t = 3.34 s, vi = 0 (girayi gayi hai), a = g = 9.8 m s⁻²; maloom karna hai vf aur h.
(b) Velocity, pehli equation se: vf = vi + gt = 0 + (9.8 m s⁻²)(3.34 s) = 32.7 m s⁻¹
(a) Height, teesri equation se: vf² - vi² = 2gh, yani (32.7 m s⁻¹)² - (0)² = 2 × 9.8 m s⁻² × h
blocks.answer: h = 54.56 m (tower ki height) aur vf = 32.7 m s⁻¹ (zameen se takrane ki velocity)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Question mein (a) tower ki height aur (b) zameen se takrane ki velocity poochi gayi hai, lekin kitab ke solution mein velocity wale hisse par (a) aur height wale hisse par (b) likha hai. Pehle velocity nikalni parti hai kyun ke height usi se nikalti hai; is liye yahan velocity ko (b) aur height ko (a) likha gaya hai, question ke mutabiq. Answers wahi hain: height 54.56 m aur velocity 32.7 m s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: Ek helicopter 14.6 m s⁻¹ se oopar ja raha hai aur zameen se 156.8 m oopar hai jab us se ek patthar giraya jata hai. Patthar ko zameen tak pohanchne mein kitna time lagega?
blocks.explanation: Patthar helicopter wali oopar ki velocity le kar chalta hai. Oopar ko positive lein: vi = +14.6 m s⁻¹, a = -9.8 m s⁻², aur zameen S = -156.8 m par hai. To -156.8 = 14.6t - 4.9t², yani 4.9t² - 14.6t - 156.8 = 0. Is se t = (14.6 + √(213.2 + 3073.3))/9.8 = (14.6 + 57.3)/9.8 ≈ 7.3 s.

items: Free fall: Galileo ke mutabiq sab cheezen g = 9.8 m s⁻² se girti hain aur ek hi height se ek hi velocity se zameen par pohanchti hain; girte hue g positive, oopar phenkne par negative.
vf = vi + gt, h = vit + ½gt², vf² - vi² = 2gh. Example: 3.34 s tak girne se 32.7 m s⁻¹ aur 54.56 m.
